Chhattisgarh High Court Overturns DEO Order on Principal Appointment

The Chhattisgarh High Court has overturned an order by the District Education Officer (DEO) that removed an acting principal from their post at an Eklavya Model Residential School. The court's decision nullified the DEO's directive, reinstating the acting principal's charge.
